Close/reopen, change speaker/scene, cancel, save and reload while stages are pending.
Replay a late/duplicate stage callback.

No stale text, mood, task or inventory commit; English unavailable outcome.

cards.title: Relationship, mood and personality contrasts

One event applies once; negative severity not capped by positive friendship allowance.
